founder.thanks: Thank you for taking a look at Jupiter. I hope it gives you a little more room for the work you love
founder.label: A note from the founder
founder.title: Your work deserves more of your day
founder.note: Every appointment comes with a little work around it: finding a time, sending a reminder, keeping track of changes. I want Jupiter to make that part easier, so you can give more of your attention to the people who come to you
founder.promise: The idea is simple: clear tools for the everyday work of running a service business. A calendar you can trust, an easy way for customers to book, and fewer things to keep in your head
founder.name: Olli Salo
founder.role: Software developer and the founder of Jupiter

booking.label: Online booking
booking.title: Online booking, even when you’re busy
booking.description: Customers can choose a service, pick a team member and book an available time without calling or messaging you. Share your booking link on your website, social media or anywhere your customers find you

calendar.label: Team calendar
calendar.title: Your team’s day, clearly laid out
calendar.description: See appointments and free time in one shared calendar. Switch between day, week and list views, focus on a team member, and drag appointments to adjust the schedule when plans change

availability.label: Working hours
availability.title: Working hours that fit real life
availability.description: Set regular working hours and breaks, add time off, or open up extra hours for a busy week. Jupiter uses your availability and service preparation times to show customers suitable appointment slots

reminders.label: Reminders & changes
reminders.title: Keep customers informed automatically
reminders.description: Send booking confirmations, appointment reminders and updates when plans change. Choose when reminders go out and let customers cancel or reschedule within the rules you set

page.label: Your booking page
page.title: A booking page that feels like your business
page.description: Add your logo, a cover photo and a welcome message, then choose which services customers can book. Share your page with a simple link or a QR code customers can scan

customers.label: Customer details
customers.title: Remember the details that matter
customers.description: Keep customer contact details, past appointments and private notes together. Before the next visit, your team can quickly check what happened last time and what to keep in mind
